correct_diagnosis: Acute non-specific low back pain (mechanical lumbar strain) without red flags
matching_criterion: Acute non-specific / mechanical low back pain (lumbar strain) without red flags or radiculopathy. Any wording that names acute mechanical or non-specific low back pain counts as correct; a specific structural diagnosis (disc herniation, fracture, infection, malignancy) does not.

management_reference.management: Reassure and give advice and education about the favourable course of non-specific low back pain.
management_reference.source_quote: reassurance; advice and education with the specific mention of physical activity and exercise

management_reference.management: Advise to remain active and to resume normal activity; do not prescribe bed rest.
Short-term use of NSAIDs (or paracetamol) is an option for pain relief.

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
